items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Next time he'd come with Zeb, Georgie Boyle, you know.

ctx.x: No, the clarinet player. Playing blues. Not solo but all around throughout the beach.
Dixieland. Here. Georgie Boyle. He was great, huh? Yeah, he was one of the greatest.
What made him good on blues?
